defects.quote: IF a member who is already on the waitlists for 2 slots in a week tries to join the waitlist
defects.description: "A week" is not defined: one builder will count calendar weeks (and must still pick Monday or Sunday as the start), another a rolling 7 days, and the Tuesday-to-Friday scenarios do not settle it.

defects.quote: WHEN a booking for a slot with a waitlist is cancelled, the system SHALL book the slot for the
defects.description: Booking a cancelled slot straight for the first waitlisted member contradicts booking-cancellation.spec.md, whose Cancel 2 hours or more ahead rule shows a cancelled slot as free to every member so any of them can book it.

defects.quote: Each slot's waitlist is kept as a first-in, first-out queue stored alongside the slot's
defects.description: The constraint chooses a data structure and storage design (a first-in, first-out queue stored with the booking record); only the ordering behaviour belongs in the spec.
